divergent_ref.head: 6e8264be25dac91606e962a070ba786e79bf48fa
divergent_ref.classification: unique historical experiment; selective-port candidate; not safe to retire

evidence.finding: The branch contains substantive cross-repository motif provenance and knowledge-plane work that is not contained by current main. The motif contract is conceptually aligned with the adopted plan, but the legacy implementation owns local canonical JSON/SHA logic, imports the old daedalus.schemas surface, lives under daedalus.twin although the current execution plan assigns corpus/motif contracts to daedalus.evolution, and the branch also changes old kernel/OwnerApproval surfaces. Wholesale merge or cherry-pick would therefore reintroduce parallel/stale authorities.

divergent_ref.action: preserve the branch and its commit/blob/PR evidence; audit one responsibility at a time against current main and port only missing semantics into the current canonical owner

verification.method: GitHub exact compare main...branch for every classified ref plus direct inspection of the divergent motif-provenance blob
verification.reason: No executable product or test code changed in this packet; commit-containment and source-ownership inspection are the relevant evidence.

bounded_next_step: Audit the legacy MotifProvenance responsibility against current main and current canonical daedalus.evolution/twin contracts. Port only missing provenance invariants, using current canonical serialization/digest/provenance owners and without importing the old Gate-2 closure stack or creating a second motif registry.
